acceptance_criteria: The pre-spend check's output is quoted verbatim and the sample size is one the caps can deliver.
The prediction file is committed before the run; both shas recorded; the precedence guard passes.
The registered prediction is stated in the response before the result.
The run's terminal status is quoted verbatim, or its absence is stated plainly as the failure.
The per-criterion shape table and the abstention count are reported.
The fold's detail is quoted where an abstention occurred, demonstrating the empty seat is recorded on a live run.
The trace is committed and the mirror path quoted; one record per produced unit.
The n and the envelope ratification are both stated.
assumptions: The standing .env carries approved pins. If only the env-prefixed form exists, return BLOCKED naming G-2/G-3.
A scenario exists that exercises the criteria machinery end to end. If not, say so rather than authoring one during this command.
constraints: THE PRIMARY QUESTION, stated so it cannot drift: does a fresh live run on current main reach a terminal status within its declared bounds? A terminal is completed, blocked, or escalated-with-diagnosis. 'No terminal' is the failure this command exists to detect.
COMMIT THE PREDICTION FILE BEFORE THE RUN. Its author date must precede the run's header; the precedence guard will check it.

THE REGISTERED PREDICTION, committed verbatim in that file: the run reaches COMPLETED. Rationale: all six workflows terminate provider-free and the failure path is bounded at 31 calls against a 41-call ceiling, so the only live risk is provider variance — a 429, a schema rejection, or a malformed reply — not loop logic. If the run escalates, the reason will be provider variance and the trace must name which.

STATE THE CAP ARITHMETIC before the first call: n repetitions at a per-unit cap of C require a sweep cap of at least n x C. Run the free pre-spend check and quote its output verbatim before committing to a sample size.
ASK THE OWNER FOR THE ENVELOPE. Do not inherit a previous envelope — a new run needs a new ratification. Recommended: n=1 at a per-unit cap of $0.25. If the owner does not extend, do not run.
Pin the tiers and log the versioned answering ids (convention 23). An unpinned reading is partly a record of who answered.
Isolate the knowledge store, or state that you did not and why.
NO git operation while the run is in flight (Ruling D13). The mirror is a backstop, not a licence. The run must not start on a dirty tree.
Report the terminal verbatim, and for an escalation, whether it names its bound and whether the fold recorded an empty seat.
Record the per-criterion shape table for the run and the abstention count.
If the run reaches a terminal, this is the first fresh live demonstration and is recorded as such: n=1, one request, one observation.
If the run does NOT terminate, that is the result, reported with the trace — not a workflow defect to fix in this command.
No change to any workflow, profile, prompt or constant during this command.
